description.p: One binary, every frontend: a one-shot CLI, an interactive REPL, piped scripts, a full-screen terminal UI, and a desktop app with keypad, history, 2D and 3D graphing, value tables, statistics, units, and a script collection of hundreds of ready-to-run examples, in eight languages, fully offline.

Type a formula and the answer is already there: every statement's result renders next to its line. Quantities carry units that convert (`55 mile/hr in km/hr`), functions are one `def` away, and `graph` plots curves with roots, extrema, and intersections labelled; `graph3d` surfaces rotate and zoom. Everything evaluates on your machine: no account, no network, no telemetry.
